page_title: UDI 2-2 GEN | Udinese v Genoa 01/10/2023, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+7' There will be no more action in this match as the referee signals full time.
90+6' Maurizio Mariani shows the yellow card to Morten Frendrup (Genoa) for a heavy challenge.
90+4' That was really pointless! Sandi Lovric (Udinese) made a mindless challenge and the referee Maurizio Mariani showed him a red card.

90+1' 2 - 2 Alan Matturro (Genoa) attempts to head the ball away after a cross into the penalty area, but instead he accidentally sends it inside the right post of his own goal. The goalkeeper was helpless.
90+1' Udinese take the corner, but their hopes of scoring a goal end with a nice clearance by the defence.
90+1' Joao Ferreira (Udinese) takes a quick throw-in so that his teammates can outnumber the defenders in the penalty box.
90' We will have 5 min. of added time.
89' The resulting corner from Lazar Samardzic (Udinese) comes to nothing.
89' A good clearance by a defender means the corner comes to nothing for Udinese.
87' Alberto Gilardino has decided to introduce fresh legs, with Alan Matturro (Genoa) replacing Albert Gudmundsson.
83' A cross from a corner kick by Udinese is too strong and the ball goes well out of play.
80' Substitution. Thomas Kristensen makes way for Joao Ferreira (Udinese).
80' The free kick from long range, taken by Udinese, is intercepted by one of the defenders.
78' Alberto Gilardino prepares a substitution. Mateo Retegui is replaced by George Puscas (Genoa).
78' The game has come to an end for Ridgeciano Haps. He has contributed as much as he could today. He will be replaced by the fresh legs of Junior Messias (Genoa).
76' The Udinese players keep the ball and are exchanging a combination of passes. They are waiting for gaps in the defence to open up.
73' Referee Maurizio Mariani signals NO PENALTY for Udinese after a VAR review!

72' Play continues despite the shouts by some Udinese players for a penalty. Wait! Referee Maurizio Mariani interrupts the game right now and he will review that decision using VAR! Let's see what happens.
72' PENALTY APPEAL after Festy Ebosele (Udinese) goes down under a challenge from the defender. All players chase the referee but he's not interested in the penalty claim. Play continues.
72' Koni De Winter (Genoa) clearly holds his opponent to prevent him from getting the ball and the referee immediately stops play. A free kick is awarded to Udinese.
72' Udinese control the tempo of the game by exchanging some accurate short passes.
68' Ruslan Malinovsky will be replaced by Berkan Kutlu (Genoa).

67' Martin Payero (Udinese) outjumps the defence to meet the resulting corner and heads the ball towards the middle of the goal. The long-range header is not powerful enough, and the keeper comfortably makes a save.
66' Lazar Samardzic (Udinese) is about to take a corner kick.
66' The game is interrupted. Koni De Winter (Genoa) has violated the rules in the battle for the ball. No protests or gestures are being made as he is quite aware of what he did.
64' Udinese try to speed play up by taking a quick free kick.
63' Here comes a substitution. Martin Payero (Udinese) is brought on as a substitute for Walace.
63' Maurizio Mariani blows his whistle and signals a foul after Johan Vasquez (Genoa) brought his opponent down.
62' The shots on goal statistics – 1:3. 4:5 – this is the total number of shots produced by both teams.
60' Albert Gudmundsson (Genoa) takes the free kick from a long way out but the defender manages to get it clear.
58' Here is a change. Isaac Success is going off and Andrea Sottil gives the last tactical orders to Florian Thauvin (Udinese).
58' The referee signals that it is time for a substitution and Lazar Samardzic (Udinese) will replace Roberto Pereyra.
54' Festy Ebosele (Udinese) clips an inviting cross into the box, but there's no one in a position to get on the end of it.
52' Great teamplay by Genoa as they control the ball with a lot of short passes. Patience is the key if they want to find a gap in the defence to score.
49' The game is interrupted now, Ruslan Malinovsky (Genoa) picks up a knock and the physio has to come on.

47' Albert Gudmundsson (Genoa) rises above the opponent's defence and heads a precise cross towards the roof of the net. His effort, however, is blocked by Marco Silvestri, who pulls off a stunning save!
46' It's time for a substitution. Jordan Zemura (Udinese) comes on in place of Hassane Kamara.
46' The game restarts for the second half.
45+3' The first half of today's match has just finished.
45' The fourth official shows 2 min. of added time.
43' Maurizio Mariani shows a yellow card to Isaac Success (Udinese) for a tough tackle.
41' 1 - 2 Albert Gudmundsson (Genoa) receives a great pass from his teammate and strikes a very powerful shot towards goal that goes inside of the right post!
35' A yellow card for a tackle by Roberto Pereyra (Udinese). Maurizio Mariani doesn't hesitate at all to make this decision.
33' Neat passing move from Genoa in order to create new attacking opportunities.
30' The goal by Genoa is DISALLOWED on the advice of the video assistant referee due to an offside.
29' Wait! Referee Maurizio Mariani has indicated he is going to review the Genoa goal using VAR. It’s probably to see if there was an offside in the build-up.
28' Albert Gudmundsson (Genoa) takes a great first touch to control a killer pass on the edge of the box and curls the ball inside the right post in trademark fashion.
25' Josep Martinez (Genoa) uses bad language while talking to the referee and receives a yellow card for dissent.
25' Referee Maurizio Mariani points to the centre spot to indicate that the goal stands after the VAR review. That prompts big celebrations from the Udinese players.
25' Celebrations by Udinese are cut short as the referee signals that the legality of the goal will be checked using the VAR. Hopefully this won’t take too long.
23' 1 - 1 Lorenzo Lucca (Udinese) is first to latch on to a rebound and blasts the ball into the middle of the net. Unstoppable strike!
20' Mateo Retegui (Genoa) pulls the jersey of one of the opposition players and Maurizio Mariani blows his whistle for a foul.
19' Genoa seem to be finding their feet as they enjoy some possession. They are waiting for the right moment to create new attacking opportunities.
17' The ball is behind the sideline. Festy Ebosele (Udinese) takes a throw-in.
14' 0 - 1 Albert Gudmundsson (Genoa) scores! He latches on to a pass and produces a perfect strike from the edge of the box that goes into the roof of the net and past the goalkeeper.
12' Ruslan Malinovsky (Genoa) watches the ball all the way and connects well with a volley on the edge of the box, but sends the effort miles over the bar.
9' Mateo Retegui (Genoa) requires medical treatment, so the referee stops play and signals for the physio to come onto the pitch.
8' Albert Gudmundsson (Genoa) sends a pass into the box, but his attempt is thwarted and cleared.
4' Festy Ebosele (Udinese) sends a cross into the box, but the opposition's defence clears the ball away to eliminate the danger.
2' A cross from Ridgeciano Haps (Genoa) fails to reach the box as the defence clears the ball away to safety.
2' Some great controlled play and passing in the middle of the pitch from Udinese.
1' Here we go, today's match is starting right now.
Udinese will kick-off.
Maurizio Mariani will supervise the game today.
